title: Back-office records workspace template
purpose: A company runs its operations in one workspace: members with roles and a permissions table, single-use invitations, records with a lifecycle (draft → submitted → approved → closed, or rejected), an approvals queue, reports and a scoped CSV export, and an audit trail written in the same transaction as every change. Not for public catalogues or two-sided markets (template-marketplace) or community groups (template-membership).

security_compliance.notes: Static audit at staging (b53c63a, #190): pas check passes every hard check once APPNAME is replaced (re-run 2026-09-28; in the template itself only the placeholder check fails, by design); the manifest registers through the platform's own validation (manifest rules, :__user_id scoping, schema coherence) and the migrations pass the additive-only lint (test/template-workspace.test.ts). All 27 actions are authenticated and scoped through a workspace-membership sub-query; privileged writes check the role or a permission key in SQL; every state-changing write is a batch ending in its guarded audit row (PAS-AUTH-019). Fixes the base template's three known deviations (PAS-AUTH-001, PAS-UI-002, PAS-UI-007).
